Literal.Value: 'The data community''s own nightmare, one answer each: data arrives a mess (23 of 105), too many versions (19), doesn''t add up (17), takes forever (16), wrong hands (14), AI confidently wrong (8), never arrives (6), spotted too late (2). Closing line: we lit lanterns for the dark and set a table for the dead; the future is still waiting for its festival.'
